notes:
Top-level: CraftWright builds an IDE-first copilot for mid-large engineering shops (VS Code + internal IDEs). Evaluating Redwood for two parallel needs: low-latency in-IDE completion/streaming and high-throughput background embedding/index pipelines.

Key quotes: "We need completions to start streaming within 40-60ms for local keystroke feel; anything >100ms feels laggy." — CTO (Akira Moreno).

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Frontline: IDE copilot (completion + signature help + doc lookup) requires sub-100ms tail latency for short completions (avg 8-30 tokens). Prefer 40-60ms p50.
- Streaming: token-by-token streaming to editor with reconnection/fallback behavior. Must support function/tool calling later.
- Model/version pinning: deterministic outputs required for codegen tests; need ability to pin to specific model+quantization combo across hosted/dedicated.
- Embeddings pipeline: daily refresh of embeddings across ~12M files (code + doc blobs). Expect peak ingestion batch size ~250k docs/hour; offline indexing window 2–4 hours.
- Batching & KV caching: want automatic batching for background jobs and persistent KV prefix caches for interactive sessions to reduce repeated context recomputation.
- Throughput targets: 5k concurrent editor sessions (low qps each), and background embedding throughput 3–5k docs/min during refresh windows.
- Cost sensitivity: careful on per-token cost for continuous completion; interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization + cache policies) to control $/active-developer.
- Data controls: VPC peering for metadata, KMS for customer keys, retention/erase APIs for user data. EU residency for a subset of customers (legal blocker until clarified).

POC summary (timeline):
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (Jordan) — demo of Redwood hosted API, initial perf numbers.
- 2026-01-19: Technical deep-dive with infra + backend engs (Priya ran perf checklist). Notes: heavy interest in dedicated capacity.
- 2026-02-02: POC kickoff — Redwood provided test harness + sample models; CraftWright provided anonymized code corpus (3M files).
- 2026-02-18: Mid-POC check-in (ff_2026-02-18_98423) — Redwood observed bursty indexing; adjusted batching window and KV retention.
- 2026-02-26: Stress test (ff_2026-02-26_99877) — streaming latency measured end-to-end 45ms p50, 110ms p95 under load; background embedding throughput ~2.8k docs/min (short of target).
- 2026-03-01: Engineering sync — discussed kernel selection and quantization tradeoffs; Redwood proposed dedicated pool + 4x NVidia instances for embedding windows.

Open technical action items:
- Redwood: provide detailed perf report (p50/p95/p99) for streaming in-IDE under 5k concurrent sessions — due 2026-03-10.
- CraftWright: provide full EU-only sample set and legal PII redaction statement for residency review — due 2026-03-08.
- Joint: run a 4-hour embedding refresh sim at 3k docs/min with proposed dedicated config; produce cost estimate and autoscale plan.

- PO/Procurement: legal wants explicit data residency + audit log SLAs before committing. Pricing sensitivity around steady-state per-developer monthly cost.
